problem_statement: The Fold & Press is the working site of a two-press letterpress and bookbinding studio (operator Marren Vale, Bristol), built on this Nuxt 3 blog: a home author card with intro, expertise and studio timeline; a Blog index of studio posts; individual article pages; and a Projects listing of completed press work, all under a shared Header nav and Footer. The studio wants visitors to be able to browse the catalogue of completed work by the kind of press job. Add a 'Press catalogue' filter to the Projects grid: an eyebrow-labelled bar with a row of category tabs (All work, Bookwork, Stationery, Editions) sitting above the real project cards, plus a live result readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 · <category>'. Clicking a tab must narrow the visible cards to that category AND update the readout to the live count and label — a reader who picks Stationery must see 'Showing 2 of 6 · Stationery', never a stale 'Showing all 6'. The same catalogue bar should also travel with the studio's selected-work preview on the home page and onto the Blog index, so any reading surface can browse the work. Ship it so it (1) surfaces the catalogue bar on the home, Projects and Blog reading surfaces alike, (2) lays out its tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches the journal's quiet indigo/slate editorial styling with tidy, legible project cards (not a collapsed, overlapping pile of illegible cards), and (4) keeps the result readout in sync with the active tab. Keep the rest of the site — navigation, existing content, the Nuxt Content articles, the static build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Press catalogue' filter bar above the Projects grid (a shared PressCatalogue component), also surfaced on the home selected-work preview and the Blog index — not a per-page copy.
The bar shows a 'Press catalogue' eyebrow, a heading, a row of category tabs (All work, Bookwork, Stationery, Editions) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 6 · <category>'.
Clicking a category tab filters the visible project cards to that category and updates the readout to the live count and label; picking Stationery must read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Stationery'.
The tab row must wrap responsively so no reading surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Lay the project cards out as a tidy, legible grid in the journal's indigo/slate editorial language — cards must not collapse, overlap or clip into an illegible pile, and the active tab must stay readable.
Wire the readout to the active filter: after clicking a tab the readout must re-derive the live count and label, never show a stale captured 'Showing all 6' value.
Preserve navigation (Home/Projects/Blog), the footer, the existing home/Blog/Projects/article content, the Nuxt Content articles and the static build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the mdrathik nuxtjs-tailwind-blog Nuxt 3 theme (TheHeader/TheFooter shell, Nuxt Content articles, Tailwind indigo/slate palette, the existing ProjectCard grid on the Projects page). The Press catalogue filter reuses the theme's own project cards and local cover images and icon SVG assets; no remote images or assets are added. The filter bar, its responsive tab layout and the card grid styling read as part of The Fold & Press journal.
design_constraints: Implement the Press catalogue as a shared component mounted on the Projects grid (and the home preview / Blog index) so a single source of truth reaches every surface; do not paste divergent copies per page or bolt on a detached widget.
The category tab row must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile; tab spacing must stay legible.

The project cards must lay out as a tidy, non-overlapping grid in the journal's indigo/slate palette with a legible active tab; the image and icon assets must stay in place — no collapsed, shingled or clipped card pile.
The result readout must reflect the CURRENT active category after every tab click by re-deriving the live count and label, so it can never go stale relative to the cards on view.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, existing content, the article cover images, the Nuxt Content articles or the static build.

change_completion: The Press catalogue filter bar is present above the Projects grid and also on the home selected-work preview and the Blog index (the shared component reaches all three surfaces).
After clicking a category tab, the result readout updates to the live 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 6 of 6 · All work'.
design_consistency: The catalogue grid on the Projects/home surfaces matches the reference's indigo/slate editorial layout under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), with tidy non-overlapping cards.
The filter bar adopts the journal's indigo idiom and legible tab styling so it reads as part of The Fold & Press across the reading surfaces.
responsive: No captured reading surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the category tab row wraps.
mobile_projects, mobile_footer_home and mobile_initial keep the catalogue bar readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (Home/Projects/Blog), the footer and the Nuxt Content articles remain present and functional.
The existing home/Blog/Projects/article content and the static Nuxt build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the rebranded homepage author card and responsive shell.
desktop_blog, mobile_blog and desktop_article protect the existing reading surfaces; desktop_blog also carries the Press catalogue bar.
desktop_projects and mobile_projects show the Press catalogue filter above a tidy project-card grid without horizontal overflow.
desktop_footer_home and mobile_footer_home scroll the home selected-work catalogue into view and must show the indigo/slate bar without horizontal overflow.
desktop_footer_projects and desktop_footer_article protect the Projects catalogue grid and the article footer.
toggle_bench_home clicks the Stationery category tab on the home catalogue; the result readout must then read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Stationery'.
